about.fullText:
Hi, I'm Inbal, a professional photographer for about 10 years.

A mother of three wonderful children and wife to my amazing husband!

I live and breathe the perfect vibe of beautiful Israel, with its landscapes, beaches and the best people you could ask for.

I've always had a passion for documenting, immortalizing, bringing joy and bringing out the best in people.

For as long as I can remember, I've always had a camera in hand, documenting moments with family and friends, until I realized I needed to capture these small, precious moments for others too - moments that will last forever.

In every session, I always find the light and connection between you. These small moments are what I feel are the biggest moments of all.
